fields.Name: Referrals.MatchProfessionals
fields.Description: Matches and ranks verified professionals for a referral request using multi-factor scoring and conflict screening.

fields.Name: PracticeAreaID
fields.Description: UUID of the PracticeArea to match against.

fields.Name: JurisdictionID
fields.Description: UUID of the Jurisdiction to match against.

fields.Name: RequiresProBono
fields.Description: Whether the referral requires a pro bono-accepting professional.

fields.Name: PreferredLanguage
fields.Description: Optional preferred spoken language for the match.

fields.Name: SLAResponseHours
fields.Description: Optional target SLA response window in hours used for responsiveness scoring.

fields.Name: MaxResults
fields.Description: Maximum number of ranked candidates to return (default 20).

fields.Name: ReferralRequestID
fields.Description: Optional existing ReferralRequest UUID for conflict-screening context.

fields.Name: Referrals.RouteReferral
fields.Description: Routes a referral request through sequential SLA-backed cascade offers.

fields.Name: ReferralRequestID
fields.Description: UUID of the ReferralRequest to route.

fields.Name: Referrals.RespondToReferral
fields.Description: Processes a professional accept, decline, or conflict rejection on a referral assignment.

fields.Name: ReferralAssignmentID
fields.Description: UUID of the ReferralAssignment being responded to.

fields.Name: Action
fields.Description: Response action: Accept, Decline, or ConflictReject.

fields.Name: Notes
fields.Description: Optional free-text notes about the response.

fields.Name: DeclineReason
fields.Description: Optional structured reason when declining or conflict-rejecting.

fields.Name: Referrals.SweepExpiredReferralSLAs
fields.Description: Sweeps expired SLA referral offers and cascades to the next eligible professional.

fields.Name: AsOfIso
fields.Description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp to sweep as-of (defaults to now).

fields.Name: Referrals.VerifyCredential
fields.Description: Verifies a professional credential using a pluggable verification provider and persists the normalized result.

fields.Name: ProfessionalProfileID
fields.Description: UUID of the ProfessionalProfile owning the credential.

fields.Name: ProfessionalCredentialID
fields.Description: Optional UUID of an existing ProfessionalCredential record to verify.

fields.Name: CredentialCode
fields.Description: License or credential code (e.g., NY-BAR-441021).

fields.Name: CredentialName
fields.Description: Human-readable credential title.

fields.Name: LicenseNumber
fields.Description: Optional license number associated with the credential.

fields.Name: IssuerName
fields.Description: Name of the licensing board or issuing authority.

fields.Name: ProviderKey
fields.Description: Credential provider key: Manual, ExternalAction, or BizAppsCredentialingBridge.

fields.Name: JurisdictionID
fields.Description: Optional Jurisdiction UUID associated with the credential.

fields.Name: ExternalReferenceID
fields.Description: External registry reference identifier.

fields.Name: EvidenceURL
fields.Description: URL to verification evidence or registry record.

fields.Name: ForceStatus
fields.Description: Optional coordinator status decision (Pending, Verified, Rejected, Expired, Revoked) for Manual provider.

fields.Name: Referrals.SyncProfileCredentials
fields.Description: Synchronizes normalized credentials for a professional profile from a specified verification provider.

fields.Name: ProfessionalProfileID
fields.Description: UUID of the ProfessionalProfile whose credentials are synchronized.

fields.Name: ProviderKey
fields.Description: Credential provider key to synchronize from.

fields.Name: Referrals.ListCredentialProviders
fields.Description: Lists all registered credential verification providers and their runtime availability.

fields.Name: Providers
fields.Description: Array of registered CredentialProviderDescriptor objects.

fields.Name: Referrals.SubmitReferralIntake
fields.Description: Atomically creates a ReferralRequest and all ConflictCheckParty records in one transaction, marks it Submitted, and optionally routes it immediately.

fields.Name: SeekerName
fields.Description: Name of the referral seeker.

fields.Name: SeekerEmail
fields.Description: Email address of the referral seeker.

fields.Name: PracticeAreaID
fields.Description: UUID of the requested PracticeArea.

fields.Name: JurisdictionID
fields.Description: UUID of the requested Jurisdiction.

fields.Name: ReferralTierID
fields.Description: UUID of the ReferralTier governing SLA and cascade policy.

fields.Name: MatterTitle
fields.Description: Short title of the matter.

fields.Name: MatterSummary
fields.Description: Full-text summary of the matter.

fields.Name: RequiresProBono
fields.Description: Whether the matter requires a pro bono-accepting professional.

fields.Name: PreferredLanguage
fields.Description: Optional preferred spoken language.

fields.Name: ConflictPartiesJSON
fields.Description: Optional JSON array of ConflictPartyInput records to screen.

fields.Name: AutoRoute
fields.Description: When true, immediately routes the referral after submission.

fields.Name: Referrals.MarkReferralInProgress
fields.Description: Transitions an accepted referral assignment (and its parent request) to InProgress.

fields.Name: ReferralAssignmentID
fields.Description: UUID of the Accepted ReferralAssignment to mark InProgress.

fields.Name: Referrals.CompleteReferral
fields.Description: Transactionally completes a referral: creates a ReferralOutcome, marks the assignment and request Completed, and updates professional capacity/response metrics.

fields.Name: ReferralAssignmentID
fields.Description: UUID of the Accepted or InProgress ReferralAssignment to complete.

fields.Name: OutcomeStatus
fields.Description: Outcome status: Completed, Cancelled, or NoEngagement.

fields.Name: CompletionNotes
fields.Description: Optional free-text completion notes.

fields.Name: Referrals.SetAvailabilityWindow
fields.Description: Creates or updates a recurring, date-range, or blackout availability window for a professional.

fields.Name: ProfessionalAvailabilityWindowID
fields.Description: Optional UUID of an existing window to update; omit to create a new one.

fields.Name: ProfessionalProfileID
fields.Description: UUID of the ProfessionalProfile the window applies to.

fields.Name: WindowType
fields.Description: OnLeave, Paused, or ReducedCapacity.

fields.Name: StartsAt
fields.Description: ISO-8601 start timestamp for the window.

fields.Name: EndsAt
fields.Description: ISO-8601 end timestamp for the window; must be strictly after StartsAt.

fields.Name: CapacityOverride
fields.Description: Non-negative concurrent-referral cap override; required for ReducedCapacity windows.

fields.Name: Reason
fields.Description: Optional free-text reason for the window.

fields.Name: IsActive
fields.Description: Whether the window is active; defaults to true.

fields.Name: Referrals.EvaluateEscalations
fields.Description: Evaluates all Offered assignments and Urgent requests for SLA-warning and urgent-unassigned escalation conditions.

fields.Name: AsOfIso
fields.Description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp to evaluate as-of (defaults to now).

fields.Name: NotifierKey
fields.Description: Escalation notifier to invoke: None or BizAppsTasks.

fields.Name: Referrals.AcknowledgeEscalation
fields.Description: Coordinator/admin acknowledgement of an Open referral escalation.

fields.Name: ReferralEscalationID
fields.Description: UUID of the Open ReferralEscalation to acknowledge.

fields.Name: Notes
fields.Description: Optional free-text acknowledgement notes.

fields.Name: Referrals.ResolveEscalation
fields.Description: Coordinator/admin resolution of an Open or Acknowledged referral escalation.

fields.Name: ReferralEscalationID
fields.Description: UUID of the Open or Acknowledged ReferralEscalation to resolve.

fields.Name: Notes
fields.Description: Optional free-text resolution notes.

fields.Name: Referrals.DismissEscalation
fields.Description: Coordinator/admin dismissal of an Open or Acknowledged referral escalation (no action required).

fields.Name: ReferralEscalationID
fields.Description: UUID of the Open or Acknowledged ReferralEscalation to dismiss.

fields.Name: Notes
fields.Description: Optional free-text dismissal notes.

fields.Name: Referrals.ReopenExhaustedReferral
fields.Description: Admin-only reopen of an Exhausted referral: re-runs matching excluding previously assigned professionals, optionally expanding to the parent PracticeArea.

fields.Name: ReferralRequestID
fields.Description: UUID of the Exhausted ReferralRequest to reopen.

fields.Name: ExpandToAncestorPracticeArea
fields.Description: When true, expands matching to the parent PracticeArea if one exists.

fields.Name: Referrals.RecomputeReciprocity
fields.Description: Recomputes and upserts ReciprocitySnapshot rows for every active professional over a period (defaults to the current UTC calendar quarter), and updates ProfessionalProfile readiness/reciprocity fields.

fields.Name: PeriodStartIso
fields.Description: Optional ISO-8601 period start (defaults to the current UTC calendar quarter).

fields.Name: PeriodEndIso
fields.Description: Optional ISO-8601 period end (defaults to the current UTC calendar quarter).

fields.Name: Referrals.GetReciprocityScorecard
fields.Description: Computes a live reciprocity scorecard (Sent/Received/Accepted/Resolved/SLABreachCount/AcceptanceRate/MedianResponseHours/ReciprocityIndex/AttributedFeeTotal) for a professional over a period.

fields.Name: ProfessionalProfileID
fields.Description: UUID of the ProfessionalProfile to compute the scorecard for.

fields.Name: PeriodStartIso
fields.Description: Optional ISO-8601 period start (defaults to the current UTC calendar quarter).

fields.Name: PeriodEndIso
fields.Description: Optional ISO-8601 period end (defaults to the current UTC calendar quarter).

fields.Name: Referrals.ExplainMatch
fields.Description: Generates an AI (or deterministic fallback) match rationale for every Offered/Queued candidate on a ReferralRequest, persisted onto each ReferralAssignment.AIRationaleJSON. Never passes seeker PII, matter text, or conflict party names/organizations to the AI advisor.

fields.Name: ReferralRequestID
fields.Description: UUID of the ReferralRequest whose Offered/Queued candidates should receive a match rationale.

fields.Name: Referrals.RecommendEscalationAction
fields.Description: Recommends (and persists) a RecommendedAction and rationale for an open ReferralEscalation via AI advisor with a deterministic rules fallback. Skips the AI call when a rationale already exists unless Force is set. Never mutates Status, EscalationLevel, CascadeOrder, or any assignment row.

fields.Name: ReferralEscalationID
fields.Description: UUID of the ReferralEscalation to recommend an action for.

fields.Name: Force
fields.Description: When true, re-runs the AI advisor even if an AIRationaleJSON already exists.
